# Devopedia

> A comprehensive developer encyclopedia covering DevOps, cloud computing, LLMs, 5G, and modern web technologies with community-driven knowledge sharing.

Devopedia is a collaborative platform for technical knowledge across infrastructure, programming, and emerging technologies. The site emphasizes community contributions, author guidelines, and accessible learning resources for developers and engineers.

## Key Topics

- Large Language Models
- 5G NR
- Machine Learning
- DevOps
- Cloud Computing
- Kubernetes
- Git
- Semantic Web
- IEEE 802.11be
- Python
- JavaScript
- MongoDB
- Google Cloud Platform
- Software Engineering
- Infrastructure Tools

## Core Navigation

- [Home](https://devopedia.org): Devopedia homepage: developer encyclopedia covering LLMs, 5G, and web technologies
- [Browse Articles](https://devopedia.org/site-map/browse-articles): Searchable directory of all Devopedia articles on DevOps, cloud, and tech topics
- [About Devopedia](https://devopedia.org/site-map/about-devopedia): Devopedia mission, history, values, and approach to developer knowledge sharing

## Emerging Technologies & AI

- [Large Language Model](https://devopedia.org/large-language-model): Technical overview of LLMs, transformers, pre-training, and fine-tuning mechanisms
- [Text Classification](https://devopedia.org/text-classification): Guide to text classification techniques in machine learning and NLP applications
- [Semantic Web](https://devopedia.org/semantic-web): Semantic Web technology: machine understanding, linked data, and AI-driven automation

## Wireless & 5G Technologies

- [5G NR Transmission Time Interval](https://devopedia.org/5g-nr-transmission-time-interval): 5G NR TTI technical specification: OFDM symbols, sub-carrier spacing, and latency
- [IEEE 802.11be](https://devopedia.org/ieee-802-11be): IEEE 802.11be (Wi-Fi 7) specification for high-throughput wireless networking
- [5G Technology Articles](https://devopedia.org/site-map/browse-articles/5g+tech): Filtered article directory for 5G technology topics and wireless networking

## Contributing & Support

- [Author Guidelines](https://devopedia.org/site-map/author-guidelines): Comprehensive guide for contributing authors: content, style, and collaboration standards
- [FAQ & Help](https://devopedia.org/site-map/faq-help): FAQ on content, authoring, DevCoins, accounts, and requested articles list
- [Community Outreach](https://devopedia.org/site-map/community-outreach): Community events, workshops, internships, and contributor recognition programs

## Optional

- [Site Stats](https://devopedia.org/site-map/site-stats): Devopedia platform statistics: articles, authors, tags, citations, and engagement metrics
- [Facebook Authentication](https://devopedia.org/site-map/user/auth/facebook): Facebook OAuth authentication integration for Devopedia user login
